floatingBadge.desc: Respect for the physical and emotional well-being of the animal. Zero coercion.

services.title: Customized Training Programs
services.subtitle: Whether you have a puppy to train or an adult dog with behavioral issues, I have the right solution for you.

about.title: Welcome to Atomic Dog
about.p1: I am a passionate canine behaviorist. My goal isn't just to train your dog, but to teach you how to understand them.
about.p2: No more coercive methods. Here, we work with motivation, play, and respect for the animal's needs to achieve lasting everyday results.

bilan.title: Behavioral Assessment
bilan.desc: Before any training sessions, we must meet. This 2-hour home visit allows me to analyze the environment and define a customized action plan.

philosophy.title: Why choose positive reinforcement?
philosophy.desc: Moving away from outdated punitive methods, my work is based on the science of learning and canine ethology.
